answer: Each peer’s EigenTrust score combines normalized local trust with reciprocity-weighted transitive referrals, then decays exponentially at a fixed half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained honest service. A freshly spawned sybil—whether labeled saffron, copper, or river—has near-zero eigenvector centrality; clustered endorsements cannot create credible paths without reciprocal history, leaving its score below the consensus threshold.
